ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5% high-intensity pixels originating from scarring, epibionts, and localized markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid black pigmentation across >95% of visible area; high-contrast white/tan cluster on far-left tip; scattered white punctate spots across central lobes; one isolated yellowish circular spot near the lower-center fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 82 degrees relative to the inner lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical serration; left lobe displays 5 distinct high-amplitude peaks; right lobe exhibits a more continuous, lower-amplitude sawtooth pattern along the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe shows a broad convex sweep ending in a blunt, rounded tip; right lobe exhibits a more elongated, tapered convex trajectory ending in a sharper distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of approximately 30 circular, high-contrast pixel groups (barnacles) on the far-left lateral tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) visible on the right lobe, oriented at roughly 45-degree angles to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of parasitic barnacle colonization on the left distal tip; multiple linear rake marks on the right lobe; a distinct circular scar or marking in the lower central region.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast yellowish circular spot located near the lower central boundary of the fluke.
